info.name: E-Health Care API
info.description:
Complete API test suite for the E-Health Care system.

**Roles & Authentication:**
- Admin  → `POST /api/admin/login`  → stores `{{admin_token}}`
- Doctor → `POST /api/doctor/login` → stores `{{doctor_token}}`
- Patient → `POST /api/patient/login` → stores `{{patient_token}}`

All protected endpoints use `Authorization: Bearer {{<role>_token}}`.

**Variables required (environment or collection):**
- `base_url`        – e.g. `http://localhost:8080`
- `admin_email`, `admin_password`
- `doctor_email`, `doctor_password`
- `patient_email`, `patient_password`
- `admin_token`, `doctor_token`, `patient_token` (auto-populated by login scripts)
- `patient_id`, `doctor_id`, `appointment_id` (seeded / captured during run)

item.name: 01 — Admin Auth
item.description:
Authentication for the Admin role.

Base: /api/admin  |  JWT role claim: ROLE_ADMIN
Token stored in: {{admin_token}}
Filter: AdminJwtFilter reads Authorization: Bearer header

request.description:
POST /api/admin/login — Authenticates with AdminDTO { email, password }.

On success returns { "token": "<jwt>" }.
The test script extracts and stores the token in {{admin_token}}.

JWT claims: { sub: email, role: "ROLE_ADMIN", iat, exp (24h) }
Secret: jwt.admin.secret from application.properties
Negative test — verifies that invalid credentials return HTTP 401 with an error payload.

POST /api/admin/logout — Clears the server-side SecurityContext.

Requires: Authorization: Bearer {{admin_token}}

item.name: 06 — Doctor Auth
item.description:
Authentication for the Doctor role.

Base: /api/doctor  |  JWT role claim: ROLE_DOCTOR
Token stored in: {{doctor_token}}
Filter: DoctorJwtFilter — reads Authorization: Bearer header first, then jwt-doctor-token cookie

request.description:
POST /api/doctor/login — Authenticates with DoctorDTO { email, password }.

On success returns { message: 'Login successful', token: '<jwt>' }.
The token is also set as the jwt-doctor-token cookie.
JWT claims: { sub: email, role: 'ROLE_DOCTOR', iat, exp (24h) }
Secret: jwt.doctor.secret from application.properties

Note: DoctorDTO has @NotBlank on email and password.
Negative test — verifies that invalid credentials return HTTP 401.

POST /api/doctor/logout — Clears SecurityContext and expires the jwt-doctor-token cookie.

Requires: Authorization: Bearer {{doctor_token}}

item.name: 07 — Doctor Profile
item.description:
Doctor self-service profile endpoints.

Base: /api/doctor  |  Requires: {{doctor_token}}

request.description: Re-authenticates the doctor so that the profile and appointment tests have a valid token, even if the previous logout test cleared it.

Source: DoctorApiController.getProfile()
Response: DoctorDTO { id, email, firstName, lastName, field, phone, address, avatar }
Token identity is used to look up the doctor — no ID path parameter needed.
